title: Alternating unit resolution of an exact periodic pair
statement: In the abelian category of module sheaves over a commutative ring sheaf R, endomorphisms f and g of the unit with fg=gf=0 and exact alternating pairs define a bounded-above K-flat unit resolution of cokernel(g). Tensoring it with a module M annihilated by both maps gives M as every nonpositive cohomology.

source.place: Order 1429, residue counterexample in (1); normalized tensor and periodic free resolutions, Stacks Tags 06YU and 0118.

proof.text: Construct the alternating complex with units in nonpositive degrees and zero terms above zero. Exactness in negative degrees alternates the two assumed exact pairs. Exactness at the augmentation identifies degree-zero homology with the cokernel. The terms are flat and the complex is bounded above, so it is K-flat. After tensoring both differentials vanish, and the homology universal property identifies each nonpositive homology with the unit tensor M.

lean.statement:
theorem alternatingUnit_resolution
    (f g : End (unit ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)))
    (hfg : f ≫ g = 0) (hgf : g ≫ f = 0)
    (hef : (ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).Exact)
    (heg : (ShortComplex.mk g f hgf).Exact) :
    letI := isMonoidal_W_independentCoefficients R
    letI := monoidalCategory R
    letI := tensorPreadditive R
    ∃ (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{r}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ℤ)
      (p : P ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (cokernel g)),
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolutionIndependentCoefficients p ∧
      ∀ (M : SheafOfModules.{r}
          ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R))
        (i : ℤ), i ≤ 0 → (MonoidalCategory.tensorRight M).map f = 0 →
        (MonoidalCategory.tensorRight M).map g = 0 →
        Nonempty ((HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor _ (.up ℤ) i).obj
          (((MonoidalCategory.tensorRight M).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≅
            (MonoidalCategory.tensorRight M).obj (unit _))
